name: project.rename

name: sequence.delete
description: Delete a sequence.

description: Duplicate a sequence (new ids for every track, clip and marker).

description: Open a sequence in the Timeline / Program monitor.

name: sequence.set_playhead
description: Move the playhead (current time indicator).

description: Set or clear the sequence In/Out marks (only the given mark changes).

name: track.add
description: Add a video, audio or caption track.

kind.title: Kind

index.description: position in the track list; default appends (top video / bottom audio)
index.title: Index

name: track.remove
description: Delete a track and its clips.

name: track.set
description:
Set track header toggles (lock, sync lock, eye, mute, solo, target), name, or an audio track's
mixer volume / pan.

name: sequence.set_master
description: Audio Track Mixer's Mix fader: the sequence's master volume.

name: sequence.set_patch

Source patching (the V1/A1 source indicators): which tracks Insert/Overwrite put source video and
audio on, independent of track targeting (which drives paste, Match Frame and edit-point navigation).

video_track_id.title: Video Track Id

audio_track_id.description: track that source audio is patched to
audio_track_id.title: Audio Track Id

clear_video.description: unpatch video: Insert/Overwrite places no video
clear_video.title: Clear Video

auto.description: back to following targeting (the first targeted track)
auto.title: Auto

name: clip.place
description: Place media on the timeline (Insert ',' / Overwrite '.'), video and audio linked.

source_in.description: source time; default media In mark or 0
source_in.title: Source In

source_out.description: source time; default media Out mark or end
source_out.title: Source Out

name: clip.razor
description: Razor / Add Edit (Ctrl+K) at a time.

track_ids.description: default: all unlocked tracks (Add Edit to All Tracks)
track_ids.title: Track Ids

name: sequence.remove_ranges
description: Lift or Extract one or more time ranges across tracks (e.g. silence cuts).

ripple.description: true = Extract (close gap), false = Lift (leave gap)
ripple.title: Ripple

name: clip.remove
description: Delete clips (Clear) or Ripple Delete them.

name: clip.move
description: Drag clips in time and/or across tracks (overwrite, or Ctrl-drag insert).

track_delta.description: move up (+) / down (-) within the same track kind
track_delta.title: Track Delta

name: clip.trim
description: Trim a clip's In (start) or Out (end) edge, optionally rippling.

delta.description: positive moves the edge later; may be negative
delta.title: Delta

ripple.description: Ripple Edit (B / Q / W): shift later clips
ripple.title: Ripple

name: clip.set_speed
description: Clip Speed/Duration (Ctrl+R).

reverse.description: Reverse Speed: play the same frames back to front; default keeps the direction
reverse.title: Reverse

name: clip.frame_hold
description: Frame Hold (Premiere's Frame Hold Options / Add Frame Hold / Insert Frame Hold Segment) on a video clip.

mode.description: hold: Frame Hold Options (the whole clip shows one frame); add: Add Frame Hold (split at the playhead, hold from there); insert: Insert Frame Hold Segment (a held segment of `duration` at the playhead, later clips ripple); clear: remove the hold
mode.title: Mode

source_time.description: hold_on source: the source time to hold
source_time.title: Source Time

name: clip.set
description: Set clip name, Enable (Shift+E), label color, opacity, volume or audio gain.

name: clip.link
description: Link clips so they select, move and trim together.

name: clip.unlink
description: Unlink clips.

name: marker.add
description:
Add a marker (M): a sequence marker, or a clip marker on a clip's media (clip_id: at the source
time under the playhead) or on a media item (media_id: at source time `at`).

at.description: sequence time (default playhead); with media_id: source time
at.title: At

clip_id.description: a clip marker on this clip (stored on its media at the source time under `at`), like M with a clip selected in Premiere's Timeline
clip_id.title: Clip Id

media_id.description: a clip marker on this media at source time `at` (Source monitor M)
media_id.title: Media Id

name: marker.update
description: Edit a marker (sequence marker, or a clip marker with media_id / clip_id).

media_id.description: a clip marker of this media (at is then source time)
media_id.title: Media Id

clip_id.description: a clip marker of this clip's media
clip_id.title: Clip Id

name: marker.remove
description: Delete markers (sequence markers, or clip markers with media_id / clip_id).

clip_id.description: clip markers of this clip's media
clip_id.title: Clip Id

name: clip.align_marker
description:
Put a clip marker on a time (a caption start, a cut, the playhead): mode speed changes the
clip's speed so the marked moment lands there while the clip keeps its start, first frame and
end (it ends earlier only if the media runs out); mode move slides the clip instead.

marker_id.description: a clip marker of the clip's media; default the first one inside the clip
marker_id.title: Marker Id

at.description: where the marker should land (sequence time); default the playhead
at.title: At

mode.description: speed: change the clip's speed, keeping where it starts and its first frame; move: slide the clip in time
mode.title: Mode

name: caption.add_track
description: New caption (subtitle) track: a video track whose cues are text in one track style.

style.description: CaptionStyle fields to set (font_family, font_size, color, stroke_color, stroke_width, background, align, position, ...)
style.title: Style

name: caption.set_style
description: Change a caption track's style (Premiere's track style): restyles every cue at once.

style.description: CaptionStyle fields to change; every cue on the track follows
style.title: Style

name: caption.add
description: Add a caption cue (it overwrites whatever cue it lands on).

track_id.description: caption track; default the topmost one (created if there is none)
track_id.title: Track Id

name: caption.set
description: Edit a cue's text and/or its per-cue style overrides.

style.description: per-cue overrides to merge (null values remove an override)
style.title: Style

clear_style.description: drop every per-cue override (back to the track style)
clear_style.title: Clear Style

name: caption.import_srt
description: Import an .srt file as caption cues (frame-snapped; overlapping cues are trimmed to follow each other).

track_id.description: caption track to fill; default a new one named after the file
track_id.title: Track Id

replace.description: with track_id: delete the track's cues first
replace.title: Replace

name: caption.apply_style
description:
Apply a text style to a caption track (Premiere's Track Style): font, size, fill, stroke, shadow,
background, tracking and alignment, and the style's Align and Transform when it has one, for every cue.

style_id.description: a text style from styles.list (imported from Premiere .prtextstyle files)
style_id.title: Style Id

name: caption.from_graphics
description:
Turn a track of one-line text graphics (e.g. imported subtitles) into a caption track: the first
graphic's text style becomes the track style, each graphic becomes a cue (differences from the track
style are kept as per-cue overrides). Timing, Motion, keyframes and effects stay as they are.

name: caption.to_graphics
description: Upgrade Caption to Graphic: cues become ordinary text graphic clips (editable layer by layer).

track_id.description: every cue of this caption track ...
track_id.title: Track Id

name: asset.add
description: New project item: import captions (.srt) or a Motion Graphics Template, or New Item > Adjustment Layer.

name: asset.remove
description: Delete project items (clips already on timelines stay).

name: asset.place
description:
Put a project item on the timeline: captions become cues on a caption track, a template a graphic
clip, an adjustment layer an adjustment clip on the first free video track above what is there.

at.description: default: the playhead (captions: the sequence start, where they were timed)
at.title: At

track_id.description: adjustment/template: a video track; captions: a caption track (default a new one)
track_id.title: Track Id

name: clip.audio_gain
description: Audio Gain: set, adjust, or normalize the clip gain of audio clips (peaks measured on the media).

mode.description: set: Set Gain to; adjust: Adjust Gain by; normalize_max: Normalize Max Peak to (one gain change for the selection, its loudest peak lands on db); normalize_all: Normalize All Peaks to (each clip)
mode.title: Mode

name: clip.set_audio_tag
description: Essential Sound: mark audio clips as Dialogue, Music, SFX or Ambience (or clear the type).

tag.description: Essential Sound type; null clears it
tag.title: Tag

name: audio.auto_tag
description:
Essential Sound Auto-Tag: classify audio clips as dialogue / music / sfx / ambience from the file
name and the sound (syllable-rate modulation and pauses, noise flatness, length).

clip_ids.description: default: every audio clip of the sequence
clip_ids.title: Clip Ids

overwrite.description: re-tag clips that already have a type
overwrite.title: Overwrite

name: audio.auto_match
description:
Essential Sound Loudness Auto-Match: set each tagged clip's Audio Gain so it lands on its type's target.

Measured as the clip plays (speed and its audio effects included), on integrated loudness (a clip under
a second of sound on its loudest moment). Cuts of one source share one gain
so a performance keeps its dynamics; music under dialogue is matched as a bed below the dialogue target;
gains respect a true-peak ceiling and a boost limit; clips with a compressor or limiter are re-measured
at the new gain.

clip_ids.description: default: every tagged audio clip of the sequence
clip_ids.title: Clip Ids

targets.description: LUFS per type, e.g. {'dialogue': -16}; defaults: dialogue -23, music -25, sfx -21, ambience -30
targets.title: Targets

music_bed_db.description: music playing under dialogue is matched this many LU below the dialogue target (null: match music to its own target everywhere)
music_bed_db.title: Music Bed Db

peak_ceiling.description: true-peak ceiling (dBTP) no clip may exceed after its gain
peak_ceiling.title: Peak Ceiling

name: audio.reset_match
description: Essential Sound Loudness Reset: undo Auto-Match on the clips (the Audio Gain they had before).

name: clip.roll
description:
Rolling Edit (N): move an edit point, trimming the outgoing clip's Out and the incoming clip's In
together so nothing else moves. Without a neighbor it trims that edge alone.

delta.description: sequence ticks the mouse moved (positive = later)
delta.title: Delta

name: clip.slip
description:
Slip (Y): keep the clip where it is and shift its In and Out in the source. Dragging right
(positive delta) shows earlier source frames, as in Premiere.

delta.description: sequence ticks the mouse moved (positive = later)
delta.title: Delta

name: clip.slide
description:
Slide (U): move the clip along the timeline keeping its content, while the clips around it
give and take: the previous clip's Out and the next clip's In follow, so the sequence length stays.
A gap next to the clip is used up first.

delta.description: sequence ticks the mouse moved (positive = later)
delta.title: Delta

name: clip.rate_stretch
description:
Rate Stretch (R): drag an edge to change the clip's duration by changing its speed; the same
source frames play, faster or slower.

delta.description: sequence ticks the mouse moved (positive = later)
delta.title: Delta

name: clip.paste
description:
Paste (Ctrl+V) / Paste Insert (Ctrl+Shift+V): copies of clips at the playhead, keeping their
spacing, tracks, links, effects and keyframes. The playhead moves to the end of the pasted clips.

track_id.description: the track it was copied from (pasted onto the same track, or shifted by track_offset)
track_id.title: Track Id

clip.description: the copied clip as it appears in the document
clip.title: Clip

at.description: where the earliest clip lands; default the playhead
at.title: At

name: clip.paste_attributes
description:
Paste Attributes (Ctrl+Alt+V): copy Motion, Opacity, Volume, speed (Time Remapping) and effects
— with their keyframes — from a copied clip onto the selected clips. Video attributes go to video
clips and Volume to audio clips; keyframes keep their offset from the clip start.

scale_keyframes.description: Scale Attribute Times: stretch keyframes to each target's length
scale_keyframes.title: Scale Keyframes

name: clip.resync
description:
Out-of-sync linked clips (the red offset on the clip): Move into Sync or Slip into Sync
against its linked partner.

mode.description: Move into Sync (shift the clip) or Slip into Sync (shift its content)
mode.title: Mode

name: clip.set_property
description: Set a Motion/Opacity/Volume property. If it is animated, adds or updates the keyframe at `at` (like Premiere).

at.description: sequence time used when the property is animated; default playhead
at.title: At

name: clip.set_keyframe_ease
description: Bezier handle of a Motion/Opacity/Volume keyframe: speed and influence on one side.

t.description: the keyframe's time (source ticks, as stored)
t.title: T

speed.description: value units per second (points: pixels per second along the path)
speed.title: Speed

name: clip.toggle_animation
description: The stopwatch: start animating (keyframe at `at` with the current value) or stop (drop keyframes, keep value at `at`).

name: clip.keyframe
description: Add / remove / toggle a keyframe at a time (the diamond button), or change its interpolation.

name: clip.set_keyframes
description: Replace a property's keyframes in one go (times are relative to the clip's start).

keyframes.description: [{t: clip-relative time (ticks or '1.5s'), v, interp}] - replaces all; [] stops animating
keyframes.title: Keyframes

name: clip.reset_motion
description: Reset Motion and Opacity to defaults and remove their keyframes.

name: clip.set_uniform_scale
description: Uniform Scale checkbox.

name: clip.fit_to_frame
description: Set to Frame Size (fit) / Scale to fill (fill): centers the clip and sets Scale.

name: graphic.create_text
description: Type tool: create a graphic clip with one text layer.

box.description: area text [w, h]; pass null to make point text
box.title: Box

shadow.description: {color, opacity, angle, distance, blur}; null removes it
shadow.title: Shadow

track_id.description: default: the lowest video track with nothing there at that time (a new track only when all are taken)
track_id.title: Track Id

name: graphic.create
description: New Graphic (Properties panel): an empty graphic clip to add text and shape layers to.

track_id.description: default: the lowest video track with nothing there at that time (a new track only when all are taken)
track_id.title: Track Id

name: graphic.place_mogrt
description:
Place a Motion Graphics Template: its text layers become an editable graphic clip (styling is
best effort; animation in the template is not reproduced).

path.description: a .mogrt (or .aegraphic) Motion Graphics Template made in After Effects
path.title: Path

track_id.description: default: the first free video track above what is there
track_id.title: Track Id

texts.description: template text fields by layer name -> new text
texts.title: Texts

name: graphic.apply_style
description: Apply a text style to every text layer of graphic clips (formatting only; positions stay).

name: graphic.set_layer
description: Edit a text layer: text, font, size, colors, stroke, alignment, position, scale, rotation, opacity.

box.description: area text [w, h]; pass null to make point text
box.title: Box

shadow.description: {color, opacity, angle, distance, blur}; null removes it
shadow.title: Shadow

name: graphic.add_layer
description: Add another text layer to a graphic clip.

box.description: area text [w, h]; pass null to make point text
box.title: Box

shadow.description: {color, opacity, angle, distance, blur}; null removes it
shadow.title: Shadow

name: graphic.remove_layer
description: Remove a text, shape or image layer from a graphic clip.

name: graphic.create_shape
description: Rectangle/Ellipse tool: create a graphic clip with one shape layer.

fill.description: fill color; null (or fill_enabled=false) = no fill
fill.title: Fill

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] sequence pixels; default a centered box
rect.title: Rect

track_id.description: default: the lowest video track with nothing there at that time (a new track only when all are taken)
track_id.title: Track Id

name: graphic.add_shape
description: Add a rectangle or ellipse layer on top of a graphic clip's layers.

fill.description: fill color; null (or fill_enabled=false) = no fill
fill.title: Fill

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] sequence pixels; default a centered box
rect.title: Rect

name: graphic.set_shape
description: Edit a shape layer: fill, stroke, size, path, position, anchor, scale, rotation, opacity.

fill.description: fill color; null (or fill_enabled=false) = no fill
fill.title: Fill

width.description: resize the path about its center
width.title: Width

path.description: replace the path (vertices [x, y, in_x, in_y, out_x, out_y])
path.title: Path

name: graphic.add_image
description:
New Layer > From File: put an image on top of a graphic clip's layers. By default it sits in
the middle of the frame at full size, scaled down to fit when it is larger than the frame.

crop_left.description: percent of the image hidden from the left
crop_left.title: Crop Left

name: graphic.set_image
description:
Edit an image layer: replace its file, position, anchor, scale, rotation, opacity, crop (per layer, which
Premiere cannot do inside a graphic), visibility, blend.

crop_left.description: percent of the image hidden from the left
crop_left.title: Crop Left

path.description: replace the picture (keeps position and scale)
path.title: Path

name: graphic.move_layer
description: Reorder a graphic's layers (Essential Graphics stacking order).

index.description: new position in the stack, 0 = bottom; negative counts from the top
index.title: Index

name: graphic.match_style
description:
Give every text layer of the clips the style of one text layer (font, size, colours, stroke,
shadow, alignment, tracking; optionally position) in one step - the text itself stays.

source_layer_id.description: default: the source's first text layer
source_layer_id.title: Source Layer Id

clip_ids.description: graphic clips whose text layers take the style
clip_ids.title: Clip Ids

include_position.description: also copy the layer position and area box
include_position.title: Include Position

name: graphic.replace_text
description: Find and replace in every text layer (the Text panel's Replace All), styled spans included.

clip_ids.description: default: every graphic clip of the sequence
clip_ids.title: Clip Ids

name: effect.add
description:
Apply an effect (drag from the Effects panel) to clips or whole tracks. Video effects run in stack
order before Motion; audio effects after Audio Gain and before Volume. Track effects apply to every
clip of the track without changing the clips (caption tracks included).

track_ids.description: or tracks: a track effect applies to every clip of the track (video: after the clip's Motion; audio: on the track bus)
track_ids.title: Track Ids

index.description: position in the effect stack; default last
index.title: Index

anchor.description: track effects: keyframe times count from each clip's In / Out, or stretch over it
anchor.title: Anchor

name: effect.apply_preset
description:
Apply an effect preset: its effects are appended with keyframes fitted to each clip
(anchored to the clip's in or out point, or scaled to its length, as saved). On a track, the
effects become track effects that fit every clip of the track the same way.

track_ids.description: or tracks: the preset becomes track effects, its keyframes fitted to every clip of the track (each cue animates on its own)
track_ids.title: Track Ids

preset_id.description: an id from presets.list (the Effects panel's Presets folder)
preset_id.title: Preset Id

name: effect.remove
description: Delete an effect from a clip or track.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

name: effect.set
description: Toggle an effect on/off, reorder it in the stack, or (track effects) change its anchor.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

anchor.description: track effects: what keyframe times count from
anchor.title: Anchor

name: effect.set_param
description: Set an effect parameter; if it is animated, adds or updates the keyframe at `at`.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

at.description: sequence time used when the parameter is animated; default playhead
at.title: At

name: effect.toggle_animation
description: The stopwatch for an effect parameter.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

name: effect.set_keyframe_ease
description: Bezier handle of an effect-parameter keyframe: speed and influence on one side.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

t.description: the keyframe's time (source ticks, as stored)
t.title: T

speed.description: value units per second (points: pixels per second along the path)
speed.title: Speed

name: effect.keyframe
description: Add / remove / toggle an effect-parameter keyframe at a time, or change its interpolation.

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

name: effect.set_keyframes
description: Replace an effect parameter's keyframes (times relative to the clip start).

clip_id.description: the clip whose effect it is; with track_id: the clip used as time reference
clip_id.title: Clip Id

track_id.description: a track effect: the effect is on this track
track_id.title: Track Id

keyframes.description: [{t: clip-relative time, v, interp}] - replaces all; [] stops animating. Track effects: t counts from each clip's In (anchor in) or Out (anchor out, negative)
keyframes.title: Keyframes

name: transition.add
description:
Apply a transition at a clip's start or end (drag from Effects > Video/Audio Transitions).
Between two adjacent clips it is a two-sided transition; otherwise a fade in/out.

edge.description: which edit point of the clip
edge.title: Edge

alignment.description: center at cut (default between two clips) / start at cut / end at cut
alignment.title: Alignment

name: transition.apply_default
description: Ctrl+D (video), Ctrl+Shift+D (audio), Shift+D (both): apply the default transition.

clip_ids.description: apply to both ends of these clips; default: the edit point nearest the playhead on targeted tracks
clip_ids.title: Clip Ids

name: transition.set
description: Change a transition's type, duration or alignment.

name: transition.remove
description: Delete a transition.

name: media.relink
description: Link Media: point a media item (and every clip using it) at another file.

force.description: relink even if the new file is a different kind or shorter
force.title: Force

name: media.locate
description:
Locate missing media: search a folder for files with the same names and relink them (Premiere's
Link Media > Search).

match.description: name: same file name; stem: same name ignoring the extension
match.title: Match

name: media.make_offline
description: Make Offline: the media renders as missing (the file is kept); offline=false undoes it.

offline.description: false brings it back online (if the file exists)
offline.title: Offline

name: sequence.nest
description:
Nest (Clip > Nest): move the clips into a new sequence with the same settings, keeping their tracks
and spacing, and replace them with one nested clip (linked video and audio) spanning them.

name: clip.place_sequence
description: Drop a sequence onto the timeline as a nested clip (drag a sequence from the Project panel).

sequence_id.description: the sequence to place into (default active)
sequence_id.title: Sequence Id

nested_id.description: the sequence to place as a nested clip
nested_id.title: Nested Id

name: sequence.unnest
description:
Un-nest (not in Premiere): put the part of the nested sequence the clip shows back on this
timeline, track for track, in place of the nested clip (and its linked partner). Tracks are added
when the nested sequence has more. The nested clip's own Motion, Opacity, Volume and effects
cannot be split across its contents: they are dropped and listed in ``warnings``.

clip_id.description: a nested sequence clip (its linked partner of the same sequence goes too)
clip_id.title: Clip Id

name: project.import_premiere
description: Import an Adobe Premiere Pro project: bins, media, sequences, clips, links, markers.

path.description: path to a .prproj file (read-only; never modified)
path.title: Path

bin_id.description: bin to import into; default: a new bin named after the project
bin_id.title: Bin Id

into_root.description: import bins directly into the root (used when opening a .prproj as a new project)
into_root.title: Into Root

name: keyframes.set_interp
description:
Temporal interpolation of selected keyframes (Linear, Bezier, Auto Bezier, Continuous Bezier,
Hold, Ease In, Ease Out), keeping the curve's shape where the new type has handles.

effect_id.description: or an effect's parameter: the effect ...
effect_id.title: Effect Id

times.description: the selected keyframes' times (source ticks, as stored)
times.title: Times

interp.description: Premiere's Temporal Interpolation menu; ease = Easy Ease (both sides)
interp.title: Interp

name: keyframes.move
description: Drag selected keyframes in time; a keyframe they land on is replaced (as in Premiere).

effect_id.description: or an effect's parameter: the effect ...
effect_id.title: Effect Id

times.description: the selected keyframes' times (source ticks, as stored)
times.title: Times

delta.description: sequence ticks to move by (snapped to frames by the caller)
delta.title: Delta

name: keyframes.delete
description: Delete selected keyframes; a property left without keyframes keeps the value at the playhead.

effect_id.description: or an effect's parameter: the effect ...
effect_id.title: Effect Id

times.description: the selected keyframes' times (source ticks, as stored)
times.title: Times

name: keyframes.scale
description:
Stretch or squeeze the selected keyframes in time around a pivot, frame-snapped; Bezier handle
speeds scale with them so the curves keep their shape. A keyframe they land on is replaced.

effect_id.description: or an effect's parameter: the effect ...
effect_id.title: Effect Id

times.description: the selected keyframes' times (source ticks, as stored)
times.title: Times

factor.description: new spacing / old spacing (Alt-drag the outer keyframe of a selection)
factor.title: Factor

name: keyframes.paste
description:
Paste copied keyframes (Ctrl+V in Effect Controls) at the playhead, into the same properties of
this clip: Motion / Opacity / Volume, or the first effect of the copied effect's type. Keyframes at
the same times are replaced; a property that was static becomes animated.

effect_type.description: an effect parameter: the first effect of this type on the clip ...
effect_type.title: Effect Type

keyframes.description: keyframes with `t` relative to the first copied keyframe (sequence ticks)
keyframes.title: Keyframes

at.description: sequence time where the first copied keyframe lands (the playhead)
at.title: At

name: shorts.set_copy
description:
Set the Shorts title copy (sub line above, main line below) and check that each line stays inside the frame.

Each line is rendered in its own font, size, stroke and shadow and measured where it lands
on screen. An overflowing line, a line break, or a character the font cannot draw is refused
with the measured bounds and max_hangul (how many Hangul syllables fit on that line).

hide + reveal_at is the channel's reveal: the title opens with those words as '?' and cuts to
the full copy at reveal_at (the title clip is cut there). Without hide every title clip gets
the full copy. dry_run measures without editing.

sub.description: sub copy: the upper, smaller line (null keeps it)
sub.title: Sub

main.description: main copy: the lower, larger line (null keeps it)
main.title: Main

hide.description: words of the copy shown as '?' (one per character, spaces kept) until reveal_at
hide.title: Hide

reveal_at.description: when the hidden words appear: the start of the caption where the narration first says them
reveal_at.title: Reveal At

clip_id.description: title graphic; default: every graphic clip named '쇼츠 타이틀'
clip_id.title: Clip Id

margin.description: px to keep clear at the left and right frame edges
margin.title: Margin

dry_run.description: only measure the copy; change nothing
dry_run.title: Dry Run
